display_long_description:
Step into the world of clay target shooting in virtual reality. INSANA 
Simulator covers the major international disciplines of trap and skeet 
shooting, with new disciplines and venues added regularly as the 
platform grows.

REAL VENUES, REAL FEEL
Train on faithful 360° recreations of shooting ranges from around the 
world. Each location captures the lighting, layout, and trap geometry 
of the real venue. The library expands continuously via cloud updates 
— new ranges land in your app without reinstalling.

AUTHENTIC EQUIPMENT
Choose from a growing roster of high-fidelity virtual shotguns, each 
modeled with accurate balance, mounting geometry, and visual detail. 
New models are added as the catalog expands.

VOICE-CALLED CLAYS
Launch targets the traditional way — call "Pull!" and the trap fires, 
exactly as in a real competition. Microphone detection runs entirely 
on-device; no audio is transmitted or recorded.

TRAIN OR COMPETE
• FREE PRACTICE — pick a discipline, pick a range, train without limits.
• ONLINE COMPETITIONS — official tournaments with global leaderboards 
  and ranking. Tournament schedule is set by the organizer.
• REPLAY SYSTEM — review every shot from multiple angles, with aim 
  path and pellet pattern overlays.

NO REAL FIREARM REQUIRED
The Quest controller IS your virtual shotgun. Get started in seconds 
with Guest Mode — no signup needed.

Optional eShoot Bluetooth accessory (sold separately) lets you mount a 
physical shotgun stock for maximum real
